webhooks.detail: Webhooks v3 subscription API plus new v4 webhooks journal API (beta). Subscribe to CRM object events (create/update/delete etc.) per installed app.

evidence.quote: The webhooks journal API enables third-party integrators to subscribe to real-time events, retrieve historical event data, and manage snapshots of CRM objects

sandbox.detail: Free developer test accounts (up to 10) with 90-day trial of many enterprise features; standard/CMS/development sandboxes also exist (paid tiers).

evidence.quote: You can create up to 10 test accounts to test apps and integrations without affecting any real HubSpot data.

rate_limits.summary: Marketplace-app installs: 110 requests / 10 s per installed account, plus daily limits; rate-limit headers returned

evidence.quote: each HubSpot account that installs your app is limited to 110 requests every 10 seconds.
This repository contains the Open API 3.0 schema for HubSpot's public APIs and is integrated with [HubSpot's Public API Postman Workspace]
